items.title: Grok 4.6 storms the AI frontier
items.summary_en: SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.6, scoring 61 on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index and competing with Anthropic's Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol at 60% lower cost ($2/$6 per 1M tokens). It edges Fable on professional and legal tasks and beats Sol on coding benchmarks. Grok 4.7 is expected within 3–4 weeks and is promised to surpass all current frontier models.

items.title: Claude 接管应用日常维护：388 个 PR 的实践
items.summary_en: Claude was used to autonomously handle daily app maintenance across iOS, Android, desktop, web, CLI, and Agent SDK platforms through a Slack channel. Over several weeks, it submitted 388 PRs via tasks like crash fuzzing, dead code cleanup, duplicate code unification, and abstraction policing, with 180 merged after review. Users can replicate the workflow through Claude Code, Claude Tag, or https://claude.ai/code/routines.

items.title: Grok Bot is not what you think
items.summary_en: Grok Bot, powered by Grok 4.6, lets users create personified agents with custom system prompts, inter-agent messaging, virtual computer access, and integrations like Gmail, Calendar, and Slack. Grok 4.6 ranks #1 or #2 on multiple benchmarks, matching SOL and Fable's performance at a lower cost, while Grok 4.7 is currently being post-trained on SpaceX data and will ship in 3–4 weeks. Access requires a $200/month Cursor or Grok plan.

items.title: Show HN: OpenCode Senses, An insanely fast and highly accurate vision plugin
items.summary_en: OpenCode Senses is a free, fully local vision plugin for OpenCode that analyzes images in approximately 300ms on a laptop. It uses the moondream2 model by default but supports custom models like moondream3.1 for users with powerful GPUs (e.g., RTX 3050). The plugin is cross-platform, available via NPM, and designed for screenshot inspection, reading, and reasoning.

items.title: Durable Memory: Why Vector Databases Aren't Enough
items.summary: 向量数据库只是持久记忆的一种实现方式，而非其架构定义。持久记忆是一种选择性保留策略，只存储规格说明、用户偏好、架构决策记录等有价值的信息，而非中间推理、临时工具输出等 ephemeral context。当前AI系统过度投入检索优化却忽视写入决策，导致"数字阁楼"现象——记忆一切反而无法有效检索，引发"Agentic Thrashing"。
items.summary_en: Durable memory is a curation policy, not just a vector database storage layer, meaning only intentionally preserved knowledge like specifications and policies should survive rather than ephemeral outputs. The author warns that indiscriminate storage creates a "Digital Attic," leading to retrieval failures and "Agentic Thrashing" where systems waste inference cycles reconciling contradictory history. Effective memory requires prioritizing write-side decisions to discard scratch calculations and intermediate reasoning before they clutter future context.

items.title: paperclipai/paperclip
items.summary: Paperclip 是一款开源的 AI agent 编排工具，基于 Node.js 服务器和 React UI 构建，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenClaw 等多种 agent，可将多个 AI agent 像员工一样组建虚拟公司团队，通过组织架构图、成本预算控制、审批流程和审计日志实现统一管理。相比传统手动管理多个 agent 终端的方式，Paperclip 提供统一仪表板实现目标对齐、任务派发、工作审核和费用监控。
items.summary_en: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration tool that manages teams of AI agents through a Node.js server and React UI, supporting providers like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, and Bash. It functions as an "Agentic OS" with four pillars: task management, organizational structure, agent training (Skill Studio), and cross-provider infrastructure with sandboxing and cost controls. Key features include goal alignment, per-agent monthly budgets, multi-company isolation with data separation, full audit logging, and mobile-accessible management.

items.title: Show HN: Multi-version management (by xlings) for DeepSeek Harness
items.summary_en: The `xlings` package manager now supports multi-version management for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), allowing users to install and switch between different versions (e.g., `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.1.0-rc.3`) using commands like `xlings install dsh@version` and `xlings use dsh`. It also introduces `subos` for running isolated terminal sessions with different `dsh` versions simultaneously, making parallel development and testing more convenient. The project is open-source on GitHub at https://github.com/openxlings/xlings.

items.title: hugohe3/ppt-master
items.summary: PPT Master是一个开源AI项目，能够将PDF、DOCX文档或网页等内容转换为原生可编辑的PowerPoint演示文稿，支持形状、过渡动画、数据图表及音频旁白功能。该项目基于Kimi K3模型实现——这是全球首个开放3T类模型，具备原生视觉能力和百万token上下文窗口，可理解源材料并结构化叙事。与简单填充模板的方案不同，PPT Master生成的.PPTX文件包含母版设计、原生形状和数据驱动图表，所有处理均在用户本地完成，无需平台锁定。
items.summary_en: PPT Master is an open-source AI tool that generates fully editable, native PowerPoint presentations from documents, web pages, or topics. Using the Kimi K3 model with a 1-million-token context window, it produces real PPTX files featuring native shapes, slide masters, data-backed charts, animations, transitions, and audio narration—while keeping all data local on the user's machine.

items.title: embabel/embabel-agent
items.summary: Embabel是由Spring创建者开发的JVM Agent框架，采用GOAP（目标导向动作规划）算法实现动态规划，将LLM与代码无缝结合。框架支持注解式和Kotlin DSL两种开发方式，与Spring生态深度集成，具备强类型和原生测试能力。
items.summary_en: Embabel is a JVM-based agent framework written in Kotlin (with Java support) that enables agentic flows by mixing LLM-prompted interactions with code and domain models. It features dynamic planning using Goal Oriented Action Planning (GOAP), strong typing, and a domain-model-driven architecture that supports replanning after each action (an OODA loop). Built on Spring, it offers both annotation-based and idiomatic Kotlin DSL flows, platform abstraction for local-to-production portability, and cost-effective LLM mixing including local model support.
